seed_ledger.name: Waha to Mexico (Wahalajara System Expansion)
seed_ledger.reason: Searched EIA row, trade press (Pipeline and Gas Journal, Siemens Energy and Esentia releases) and the operator announcement. The expansion is two turbo-compression units at San Juan in Chihuahua and Aguascalientes, Mexico, raising capacity from 1.3 to about 2 Bcf/d. Esentia names mining, manufacturing and data centers as demand sectors, but only for Mexican demand. No new US pipe and no US data center tie found, so it is mostly outside the US system. FERC and Texas Railroad Commission searches showed no US filing for it.

evidence.note: Pipeline and Gas Journal, March 2026, expansion scope

seed_ledger.name: ABI-1 Electric Generating Unit power plant (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: VoltaGrid behind-the-meter plant for the Vantage Frontier campus in Shackelford County. A Cleanview report and a VoltaGrid article name Energy Transfer (Oasis Pipeline) as firm gas supplier, but no source gives a lateral, route or length. The Hugh Brinson summary lists a 14-mile Abilene lateral without naming this site. Searched the air permit trail, developer pages and trade press; the TCEQ filing could not be confirmed. Possibly an on-site tap on Oasis, or the existing Abilene Laterals row P8318.

evidence.note: Cleanview report on the Frontier campus, names Energy Transfer as gas supplier
